Education. Have a doctoral degree in psychology from a graduate program in psychology accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA), the Psychological Clinical Science Accreditation System (PCSAS), or the Canadian Psychological Association (CPA) at the time the program was completed.

The specialty area of the degree must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed. For the purpose of meeting this requirement, the term "specialty area" refers to the specific specialty areas recognized by the accrediting body and not to specific job duties that might require special skills.

Currently, APA accredits doctoral programs in the specialty areas of clinical psychology, counseling psychology, school psychology, or combinations of two or more of those areas. PCSAS accredits doctoral programs in psychological clinical science.

CPA accredits doctoral programs in clinical psychology, counseling psychology, clinical neuropsychology, and school psychology. There are no job assignments in VHA that require the skills of a school psychologist; therefore, an applicant with a degree in the specialty area of school psychology is not eligible for appointment.

Strictly for the purpose of determining eligibility for appointment as a psychologist in VHA, there is no distinction between the specialty areas (with the exception of school psychology).

OR Have a doctoral degree in any area of psychology and, in addition, successfully complete a re- specialization program (including documentation of an approved internship completed as part of the re- specialization program) meeting both of the following conditions: (a) The re-specialization program must be completed in an APA or a CPA accredited doctoral program; and, (b) the specialty in which the applicant is retrained must be consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR Have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally-accredited institution, with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature. AND Internships.

Have successfully completed a professional psychology internship training program that was accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed and that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

OR New VHA psychology internship programs that are in the process of applying for APA accreditation are acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement, provided that such programs were sanctioned by the VHA Central Office Program Director for Psychology and the VHA Office of Academic Affiliations at the time that the individual was an intern; OR VHA facilities that offered full-time, one-year pre-doctoral internships prior to PL 96- 151 (pre- 1979) are considered to be acceptable in fulfillment of the internship requirement; OR Applicants who completed an internship that was not accredited by APA or CPA at the time the program was completed may be considered eligible for hire only if they are currently board certified by the American Board of Professional Psychology in a specialty area that is consistent with the assignment for which the applicant is to be employed.

(NOTE: Once board certified, the employee is required to maintain board certification.) OR Applicants who have a doctoral degree awarded between 1951 and 1978 from a regionally- accredited institution with a dissertation primarily psychological in nature may fulfill this internship requirement by having the equivalent of a one-year supervised internship experience in a site specifically acceptable to the candidate's doctoral program.

If the internship experience is not noted on the applicant's official transcript, the applicant must provide a statement from the doctoral program verifying that the equivalent of a one- year supervised internship experience was completed in a site acceptable to the doctoral program. Licensure.

Hold a full, current, and unrestricted license to practice psychology at the doctoral level in a State, Territory, or Commonwealth of the United States, or the District of Columbia.

You will be responsible for identifying and analyzing customers' information systems requirements or environments.
You will assist in reviewing construction project designs as a cybersecurity SME as required/requested; evaluating monitoring or ensuring compliance with laws, regulations, policies, or procedures.
You will integrate information systems/subsystems; develop information systems testing strategies, plans or scenarios.
You will plan and coordinate projects that involve multiple stages in the RMF process and IT systems life cycle management process.
You will define overall project requirements, oversee support of installed systems and services, and resolve a wide range of technical and management issues.
Your resume must demonstrate one year of information technology related experience in the federal service or private or public sector demonstrating the following four competencies, as defined: 1. Attention to Detail - Is thorough when performing work and conscientious about attending to detail.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency includes: completing thorough and accurate work independently, even in the most difficult or stressful situations; occasionally reviewing work completed by others. 2.

Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency includes: resolving routine and non-routine problems, questions, or complaints; developing and maintaining strong, mutually supportive working relationships with customers; conducting evaluation of support to determine quality of services and customer satisfaction, and recommending procedural changes based on customer need or changes in policy and/or regulation.

Knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services. 3.

Oral Communication - Expresses information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); makes clear and convincing oral presentations; listens to others, attends to nonverbal cues, and responds appropriately.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency includes: convincingly conveying complex information to customers; expressing information (for example, ideas or facts) to individuals or groups effectively, taking into account the audience and nature of the information (for example, technical, sensitive, controversial); making clear and convincing oral presentations; listening to others, attending to nonverbal cues and responding appropriately. 4.

Problem Solving - Identifies problems; determines accuracy and relevance of information; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

IT-related experience demonstrating this competency includes: solving complex or sensitive problems by developing and proposing strategic alternatives; identifying possible conflicts and shared benefits; helping team anticipate problems and identifying and evaluating potential sources of information; providing feedback and coaching to others to help solve problems; engaging appropriate stakeholders when developing solutions in order to understand and incorporate multiple perspectives and needs; uses sound judgment to generate and evaluate alternatives, and to make recommendations.

In addition to the above requirements, your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector.

Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: 1) Installing, configuring, enhancing and/or maintaining the Information Technology (IT) components of Facility Related Control Systems (FRCS); 2) Analyzing, solving problems and resolving conflict while working with a variety of departments and stakeholders who may have different goals for a project; 3) Managing IT project process steps, including developing project scopes, detailed work plans, schedules (using tools like MS Project), design scope, and cost estimates for complex enterprise or facility-related projects; and 4) Utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF) process and integrating RMF requirement into IT projects.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.

As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence.

What We’re Looking For: AmeriSave is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join our Enterprise Technology & AI organization. This role sits at the intersection of technology and the business, driving complex, cross-functional initiatives that span in-house built systems, operational process change, and executive-level strategic priorities.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who has led both technology projects and business initiatives end to end, ideally within a well-known mortgage lending organization, and who is equally comfortable in a Gantt chart, a stakeholder steering committee, or a working session with engineers reviewing a build.

You will be the connective tissue between technology, operations, and leadership, translating strategy into executable plans and keeping delivery honest with data.

What You'll Do: End-to-End Project Ownership: Own the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional projects, from charter and requirements through execution, go-live, and post-launch measurement, spanning both technology builds and business/operational initiatives.

Vous souhaitez non seulement évaluer les risques informatiques, mais aussi contribuer activement à leur gestion transparente et à leur traitement durable ? Dans ce rôle, vous assumez une fonction centrale pour les Risques & Contrôles IT chez Swisscard.

Vous coordonnez et développez continuellement le cadre de gestion des risques et contrôles IT et assurez son ancrage efficace dans l-entreprise. Parallèlement, vous soutenez la direction ainsi que les départements avec des analyses approfondies et des recommandations pratiques.

En collaboration avec des partenaires internes et externes, vous contribuez à renforcer la résilience et la culture de sécurité de Swisscard.

* Vous accompagnez les risques IT tout au long de leur cycle de vie et soutenez les responsables des risques dans la mise en œuvre des mesures appropriées.
* Vous gardez une vue d-ensemble des risques IT, des contrôles et des mesures grâce à des évaluations indépendantes.
* Vous identifiez précocement les lacunes, dépendances et possibilités d-optimisation, renforçant ainsi le développement durable de la gouvernance.
* Vous analysez les menaces et évolutions pertinentes et évaluez leurs impacts sur le paysage des risques et contrôles IT.
* Vous coordonnez la collaboration avec les auditeurs, la maison mère ainsi que les partenaires internes et assurez un échange efficace.
* Vous conseillez les projets et départements sur les questions de risques IT, contrôles et gouvernance, en apportant votre point de vue clair et orienté solutions.

* Vous avez de l-expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : gestion des risques IT, gouvernance IT, sécurité de l-information, contrôles internes, audit ou un environnement comparable.
* Vous aimez collaborer avec la direction, les comités de gouvernance et différents groupes d-intérêt.
* Un diplôme en informatique, informatique de gestion, gestion d-entreprise ou dans un domaine connexe constitue une bonne base. Tout aussi importantes sont votre expérience, votre vision globale et votre motivation à faire avancer efficacement les sujets.
* Vous savez expliquer clairement des sujets techniques et vous adresser distinctement à différents publics.
* Vous communiquez avec une grande aisance en allemand et en anglais, à l-écrit comme à l-oral, en adaptant votre discours à votre auditoire.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

s.h: The role is responsible for the following results
s.t:
Delivery Flow and Value
Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.
Orchestrate planning and coordination activities across multiple teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums and cross-team synchronization, and protecting the teams against interference and over commitment, to sustain focus and health velocity.
Advise Product Owners and Business Analysts in backlog management and sequencing to ensure clear cross-team prioritization.
Monitor flow and delivery health metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time, PI objective achievement) and share them with teams to celebrate progress and surface improvement opportunities
Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.
Align teams with strategic goals through transparent sequencing of work, clear identification of cross-team dependencies; own the identification, tracking, and mitigation of delivery risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.
Enablement & Coaching
Coach Scrum Masters, Business Owners, Product Owners and Business Analysts to communicated in terms of value delivered rather than requirement fulfillment.
Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.
Stakeholder Engagement
Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.

s.h: 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary
s.t:
As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.
This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform .
You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.
Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:
Customer : What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?
Product : How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?
Engineering : How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?
Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution .
🚀 What you'll own
Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.
Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform , including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.
Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.
Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.
Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements , making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.
Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.
Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.
Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.
Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.
Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.
Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.
Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

s.h: Review and interpret customer technical documentation including
s.t:
Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)
Network and communications diagrams
Site and asset specifications
PPC and controller documentation
Modbus register maps
IP addressing and network information
Functional Design Specifications
Metering and telemetry information

Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.
Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.
Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.
Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process , ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.
Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:
Gateway installation and connectivity
Operational acceptance testing
Kraken market and service testing
Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.
Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.
Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

**Gestalten Sie die AI\-Transformation von SwissComply**
SwissComply ist ein führender Anbieter von Compliance, Risk Management und Legal Dienstleistungen für Schweizer Finanzdienstleister. Unsere Stärke liegt in der Erfahrung unserer Mitarbeitenden, fundierten Methodiken und der Fähigkeit, unsere rund 300 Kunden effizient (Nutzung von Skaleneffekten), aber auch individuell zu betreuen.
Nun entwickeln wir unsere Dienstleistungserbringung weiter: Wir wollen unsere Dienstleistungen und Prozesse systematisch durch AI unterstützen. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Menschen zusammenbringt, Veränderungen wirksam gestaltet und Vorhaben bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung führt.
**Ihre Aufgaben:**
Als AI Transformation Manager führen Sie unser Transformationsprogramm operativ. Sie berichten direkt an den Chief Services \& Solutions Officer (CSSO), ein Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Fachverantwortlichen übersetzen Sie die Strategie in konkrete, messbare Resultate.
**Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten:**
Sie strukturieren das Projektportfolio über die Business Lines, priorisieren die Vorhaben und entwickeln eine realistische Roadmap. Sie erarbeiten mit den Fachverantwortlichen Zielprozesse, Business Cases und messbare Qualitäts\- und Effizienzziele.

Sie steuern Teilprojekte, Ressourcen, Budget und Abhängigkeiten und bereiten Entscheidungen für CSSO und Geschäftsleitung vor. Sie sorgen dafür, dass gemeinsam entwickelte Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden und nachweisbaren Nutzen schaffen.

Sie begleiten unsere Mandatsleiter durch die Veränderung, moderieren unterschiedliche Interessen und organisieren Schulung und Wissenstransfer. Sie schaffen Transparenz über Fortschritt, Risiken und Ergebnisse und greifen frühzeitig ein, wenn Anpassungen notwendig sind.
**Was Sie mitbringen:**
* Langjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung anspruchsvoller Transformations\- oder Digitalisierungsprogramme
* Mehrere nachweisbar erfolgreiche Umsetzungen von der Konzeption bis zur nachhaltigen Verankerung im Betrieb
* Gute Kenntnis der Finanzindustrie, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Asset Management, Compliance oder Risikomanagement
* Praktische Erfahrung mit AI\-gestützten Veränderungen sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen, Daten und Softwareentwicklung
* Die Fähigkeit, wirtschaftlichen Nutzen zu beurteilen, Prioritäten zu setzen und auch unter Unsicherheit klare Entscheidungen vorzubereiten
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
**Wie Sie mit Menschen arbeiten:**
* Sie hören zu, fragen nach und nehmen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ernst
* Sie können erfahrene Fachspezialisten für Veränderungen gewinnen und anspruchsvolle Diskussionen respektvoll führen
* Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und konstruktiver Umgang mit Kritik zeichnen Sie aus
* Sie teilen Wissen und übernehmen Verantwortung für das gemeinsame Ergebnis
**Was Sie bei SwissComply gestalten können:**
Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsleitung und grossem Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie arbeiten mit erfahrenen RM\- und Compliance\-Spezialisten und einer umfangreichen fachlichen Wissensbasis. Ihre Arbeit prägt, wie SwissComply künftig Dienstleistungen entwickelt und erbringt.
**Interessiert?**
Wir freuen uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und eine kurze Beschreibung von zwei vergleichbaren Vorhaben:
Welche Verantwortung hatten Sie persönlich, welche Ergebnisse wurden erreicht und was haben Sie daraus gelernt?
Im Auswahlprozess möchten wir Sie auch in einer gemeinsamen Fallarbeit kennenlernen.

The LNG Manager is responsible for inspecting the construction and outfitting of the related LNG equipment and that fitting is done according to international regulation, ship-s contract, technical specifications, and builder standards.

This role is controlling the quality of the materials used, the compliance with regulation and with IGF Code and highlighting any discrepancies within the approved project.

* Ensures that areas under the described discipline are built within the set timescale and in line with the approved technical design, contractual requirements, and functional requisites.

* Ensures that all commissioning activities are held in accordance with the scope and the specifications, are approved by class and relevant authorities such us Flag and USCG representatives.

* Highlights relevant aspects of the ship-s design and technical features that might jeopardise the functional requisites and must be improved for the current project or can be improved for future constructions with new building department approval.
* Assists with Plan Approval activities as required.

* Proficiency with the use of Microsoft Office (including Excel, MS Word, MS Project or equivalent and PowerPoint);
* Familiarity with Marine Rules and International Standards and Regulations.
* Ability to review new building specifications and to read and understand a variety of engineering drawings.
